newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MobileOne obtains transferable loan facility.
newsitem.headline: MobileOne obtains transferable loan facility.

text.p: MobileOne (Asia) Pte Ltd has obtained a Singapore $80 million seven year transferable loan facility, it said in a statement on Monday.
Keppel Bank is the arranger and lender for the term loan which will be used to finance the building of mobile phone and paging networks in Singapore.

Neil Montefiore, MobileOne's chief executive officer, said in the statement, "This facility...completes our medium-term pricing arrangement for constructing and operating our...paging and cellular mobile phone networks."
MobileOne is scheduled to provide services in Singapore from April 1997. It is a consortium of the Keppel Corp group, Singapore Press Holdings, Cable & Wireless and Hongkong Telecom.
